tokens.name: chassis
tokens.usage: Window background: the instrument's body. Everything sits on it.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised modules (a layer slot, the sampler section) on `chassis`.

tokens.name: display
tokens.usage: Ground of spectrogram and waveform displays only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, outlines, control borders, key shadows, selected states. 14:1 on `chassis`, 16:1 on `panel`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Silkscreen labels, units and axis ticks on `chassis`, `panel` and `display` (≥5:1 on all three).

tokens.name: seam
tokens.usage: Decorative panel seams and display gridlines. Never the only cue for a control's edge (below 3:1).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `ink` fills (selected segment, pressed key).

tokens.name: layer-1
tokens.usage: Layer 1 (Mandarina) fills: knob caps, spectrogram peak hue, selection wash. Below 3:1 on light grounds, so always pair with an `ink` outline.

tokens.name: layer-1-deep
tokens.usage: Layer 1 lines and marks that must read alone: waveform stroke, selection handles, strongest spectrogram values. 4.6:1 on `display`.

tokens.name: on-layer-1
tokens.usage: Glyphs on `layer-1` fills (7:1).

tokens.name: layer-2
tokens.usage: Layer 2 (Césped) fills. Pair with an `ink` outline on light grounds.

tokens.name: layer-2-deep
tokens.usage: Layer 2 lines and marks. 5.4:1 on `display`.

tokens.name: on-layer-2
tokens.usage: Glyphs on `layer-2` fills (5.2:1).

tokens.name: layer-3
tokens.usage: Layer 3 (Panthers) fills. Pair with an `ink` outline on light grounds.

tokens.name: layer-3-deep
tokens.usage: Layer 3 lines and marks. 5.9:1 on `display`.

tokens.name: on-layer-3
tokens.usage: Glyphs (icons, indicators) on `layer-3` fills (4.4:1); no small text on this fill.

tokens.name: layer-4
tokens.usage: Layer 4 (Violeta) fills. Reads alone at 4.9:1 on `chassis`; still outlined for consistency.

tokens.name: layer-4-deep
tokens.usage: Layer 4 lines and marks. 8:1 on `display`.

tokens.name: on-layer-4
tokens.usage: Glyphs and text on `layer-4` fills (6:1).

tokens.name: signal-rec
tokens.usage: Capture/record state only (sidechain capture LED, armed slot). 3.5:1 on `chassis`; always paired with the word REC.

tokens.name: signal-ok
tokens.usage: Render finished / loaded LED. Same hue as `layer-2-deep`, so always paired with an icon or word.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The product name on the chassis, once.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drop a sound or capture from the mixer.

styles.name: silk
styles.usage: Silkscreen labels under controls, uppercase, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: key
styles.usage: Text on keys and segmented buttons, uppercase.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: Main value of a numeric stepper.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Values under knobs and faders; always with unit.

styles.name: readout-sm
styles.usage: Axis ticks and derived values (window length in ms, bin spacing in Hz).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to value; tick to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside keys and segmented buttons; label under control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between controls in a tight row (steppers).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Module inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between controls in a section (airy density).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between modules; chassis padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major regions (layer grid and sampler).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Displays: a screen is a cut-out in the panel.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Keys, steppers, segmented buttons, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Modules and the chassis edge.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Knob caps, LEDs, screws.

shadow.note: Flat offsets that read as a physical lip, never soft blur.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: Resting keys and knob caps: the edge of a physical button.

tokens.name: shadow-key-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed key (translate down by the same 3px).

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Seams, gridlines, axis lines.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Control and module outlines, icons.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: Selected state, selection outlines on displays.
